name: MOVEdot
long_description: Our agents run hardware engineering tasks that normally take hours or days in just a few minutes, allowing engineers to process 100x more data and information. Our platform allows hardware engineers to orchestrate agents for tasks such as analyzing failures across entire test campaigns, pulling the right data and KPIs from their databases, checking how conditions (like temperature or load) affect performance and reliability, and then document findings in reports and dashboards.

launches.body:
Hey everyone, we’re [**Bruno**](https://www.linkedin.com/in/bruno-finco-610999b6/) and [**Girish**](https://www.linkedin.com/in/girish-radhakrishnan/), founders of [**MOVEdot**](https://www.movedot.ai/).

# TL;DR

* When developing any sort of hardware, engineers are the bottleneck due to data/information overload, creating huge inefficiencies and waste
* We built a Cursor-like interface that allows humans and AI agents to work together on multi-modal data, achieving 10-100x efficiency
* We started with race cars and are now expanding to other industries
* [**Book a demo**](https://www.movedot.ai/) or email us ([founders@movedot.com](mailto:founders@movedot.com))

https://youtu.be/tA-4cdiJ5tI

# ❌ The Problem

Every engineer says the same thing:

> “Too much data, not enough time.”

Data collection has grown 10x, but the **same human brain** still has to make sense of it. Engineers spend days digging through spreadsheets and KPIs to find what failed. Or more realistically, they give up, leaving most data unused.

# ⚙️ The Solution

We built **MOVEdot**, an AI agent platform that allows you to use 10x more data to make decisions. It connects to data, video, and test standards, automating reports or answering questions like:

> _When did temperature spikes cause mechanical failures, and what were early signs?_

Agents process the data and produce interactive dashboards and mind maps.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95237&key=user_uploads/1931404/3f0d742e-35f8-4d25-8c7a-ccd153474570)

# 🌍 The Vision

Physical-world testing is a **$250B market** across development, durability, and validation. Our goal: give every engineering team **thousands of AI teammates** that helps them use **100%** of their data, increasing performance and shortening time to market. From racing to robotics. From proving grounds to production lines.

# 🏎️ Race Cars - Why We Started Here

We began in motorsports: time-sensitive environment with short sales cycles. Closed our first 30k deal within 2 weeks of the POC. Well, we were also race car engineers…

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95237&key=user_uploads/1931404/590dddb8-083c-4492-a213-a4695df7a028)

Since then, we’ve onboarded dozens of racing teams and have expanded into manufacturing, with a POC at [**Tractian**](https://tractian.com/en) (YC W21).

# 👥The Team

[**Bruno**](https://www.linkedin.com/in/bruno-finco-610999b6/) and [**Girish**](https://www.linkedin.com/in/girish-radhakrishnan/) worked together for 8 years as forward-deployed engineers in an automotive consulting firm, where we realized we were the bottleneck. Girish also had a stint at Tesla, seeing the same challenges.
